# Google Arts & Culture

> > A digital platform providing access to high-resolution artworks, historical artifacts, interactive cultural experiences, and immersive technologies from museums and cultural institutions worldwide.

Google Arts & Culture combines museum collections, historical maps, 3D models, and augmented reality features with AI-powered tools like Art Selfie and Art Transfer. The platform enables users to explore cultural heritage through interactive experiences, virtual galleries, and educational content spanning art, history, geography, and science.

## Key Topics

- Art Selfie
- Art Transfer
- Pocket Galleries
- Augmented Reality
- Museum Collections
- Cultural Artifacts
- Historical Maps
- 3D Models
- Face Matching
- Interactive Features
- Cartography
- Art Discovery
- Persian Empire
- Ancient History
- Mobile App

## Interactive Features & Tools

- [Camera — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/camera/selfie): Art Selfie feature for matching faces with artworks

## Historical Maps & Geography

- [Persian Empire Map — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/persian-empire-map/MgFeSMvQtkbbWQ): Historical Persian Empire map from museum collections
- [World Political Map — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/world-political-map/4gFbpjL2N5Xc7Q?hl=en): World political map showing cultural geography and regions

## 3D Models & Augmented Reality

- [Jupiter — Google Arts & Culture](https://artsandculture.google.com/asset/jupiter/KwFv1lcXm-dE1w?hl=en): 3D model of Jupiter gas giant planet with AR features
